items.title: Raid Arena Slashed Influencer Costs by 95.8% and Got 100k views in 24 hours - Here's the Playbook
items.summary_short: Every web3 project knows the influencer nightmare: Pay $10,000 upfront, get no views, repeat until bankrupt. Raid Arena flipped the script with performance-based campaigns – creators only get paid AFTER proving real engagement. Result? 100K views for $500 in under 24 hours.
